title: RSVP ERP dataset for authentication from Zhang et al 2025
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset comprising event-related potentials (ERPs) from 15 healthy participants performing a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) face authentication task. The dataset includes 57-channel EEG recordings acquired at 1000 Hz across 4 sessions spanning 200 days, with participants discriminating between self-face and AI-generated face stimuli. This dataset supports the development and evaluation of EEG-based biometric authentication systems using P300-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuracle Neusen system with 57 channels at 1000 Hz sampling rate, referenced to CPz with AFz as ground. Participants performed an RSVP face authentication task with 4 sessions over 200 days, each session containing 4 blocks of 8 sequences with 200 face images. Stimuli were presented at 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Standard 10-20 electrode montage was used.
